front_line: A profitable gene-therapy platform — if one great product can become a durable engine.
thesis: Watchlist. The business is genuinely excellent, but the price already assumes the durability the research hasn't proven, and one revenue print resolves most of the debate — so patience is nearly free. This moves to Open if the Aug 3 print shows sustained double-digit sequential VYJUVEK growth driven by new-patient starts (not price), ideally with a disclosed retention figure.
moat: A genuine regulatory monopoly around one drug — narrow but durable for years — dressed up as a platform it hasn't yet earned.
risks: Stock trades right on base case ($375 vs $370) with zero valuation cushion — deceleration re-rates the whole company, not just stalls it.
